title: Discretion at the Margin: Threshold Manipulation and Electoral Bans in Colombian Public Procurement
abstract: arXiv:2610.28965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public procurement laws trade rules against discretion with value thresholds: below them, buyers use faster and less competitive procedures. Colombia offers an unusually clean setting to measure how much buyers manipulate estimated values to stay below the line and what it costs. Thresholds are entity-specific (five budget bands set by law) and move every January with the minimum wage, while the round numbers that usually confound bunching estimates stay fixed. Using the universe of Colombian procurement records (SECOP I and II, 2011-2026; 8,569,218 SECOP II processes) and each entity-year's own threshold, we find sharp bunching of estimated values just below both legal cutoffs: 49,631 excess processes below the small-purchase threshold (86% of the mass observed in the last five percent below it) and 3,157 below the tender threshold. translated_title: 边际上的自由裁量权：哥伦比亚公共采购中的门槛操纵与选举禁令
translated_abstract: 公共采购法律通过价值门槛来权衡规则约束与自由裁量权：低于门槛时，采购方可使用更快但竞争性较低的程序。哥伦比亚提供了一个异常干净的研究环境，可用于衡量采购方在多大程度上操纵项目估算价值以保持在门槛线以下，以及这样做的代价。这些门槛因机构而异（法律规定的五个预算区间），并且每年一月随最低工资调整，而通常会干扰聚束估计的整数则保持不变。利用哥伦比亚采购记录的全量数据（SECOP I 和 II，2011-2026年；共8,569,218个SECOP II流程）以及每个机构-年份自身的门槛，我们发现估算价值在两个法定门槛线以下均出现急剧的聚束现象：小采购门槛以下有49,631个超额流程（其中86%集中在门槛以下最后百分之五的区间内），招标门槛以下有3,157个超额流程。这一峰值跟随门槛而非整数变化：它随最低工资变动，且仅出现在每个机构自身的门槛处……
tldr: 该论文利用哥伦比亚856万余条全量公共采购数据，通过门槛每年随最低工资变动而整数保持不变的独特研究设计，干净地识别出采购方系统性操纵项目估算价值以规避竞争性招标门槛的行为。
en_tdlr: Using Colombia's universe of procurement records and the unique design where thresholds shift annually with the minimum wage while round numbers stay fixed, the paper cleanly identifies systematic manipulation of estimated values by buyers to stay below legal cutoffs and avoid competitive tendering.
